newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $13.75 bln of 52-wk bills April 24.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $13.75 bln of 52-wk bills April 24.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury said it will auction $13.75 billion of 52-week bills on April 24 to raise $25 million as $13.721 billion of 52-week bills are maturing.
The bills will be issued May 1 and mature April 30, 1998.
The CUSIP number for the bills will be 9127944U5.
Amounts issued to Federal Reserve banks for their own accounts will be shown as additions to the offering amount.
Treasury said Fed accounts hold $5.740 billion of the 52-week issue that matures May 1.
